name: Ensorcell Baking Class
source:
Meet your baker, in this dating-sim memory game!

Review the recipe with your professor, find some love, and maybe learn how to bake a cake.

[From [url=https://mega-gh0st.itch.io/ensorcell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款约会模拟记忆游戏中认识你的面包师！

和你的教授一起复习食谱，找到一些爱，也许还可以学习如何烤蛋糕。

[来自[url=https://mega-gh0st.itch.io/ensorcell]itch.io[/url]]
